title: Harbison Protection Contracts Terms: Expiry and Declined Aftermarket Purchases
content:
**Condition 1. Expiry.** An active Harbison Protection Contracts contract expires on the day after its coverage end. Failures diagnosed after the coverage end are not covered even when the claim would otherwise qualify, and claims already filed before expiry are still decided and paid.

**Condition 2. Declined aftermarket purchase.** An aftermarket purchase whose inspection finds the equipment failing, leaking refrigerant, cracked, or already under a repair recommendation is declined. The contract closes from pending to cancelled, and its contract price is credited back in full as an inspection failure credit naming the contract-price charge, while the inspection fee stays charged.

**Condition 3. Only while pending.** A declined purchase is decided only while the contract status is pending, as shown on the contract record.

**Condition 4. Credit balance on a closed contract.** Any credit balance left on a closed contract is paid out to the original payment method as a refund payout naming the credit.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).**

| Inspection finding on a pending aftermarket contract | Outcome |
|---|---|
| equipment failing | declined; price credited in full; inspection fee stays charged |
| refrigerant leak found | declined; price credited in full; inspection fee stays charged |
| cracked heat exchanger | declined; price credited in full; inspection fee stays charged |
| a repair already recommended on the unit | declined; price credited in full; inspection fee stays charged |

- Coverage end 14 June 2026: the contract expires on 15 June 2026. A failure diagnosed on 15 June 2026 is not covered; a claim filed on 10 June 2026 for a failure diagnosed on 8 June 2026 is still decided and paid after expiry.
- A contract already active cannot be declined under Condition 3.
